spec.hypothesis: Type confusability (BCS) independently predicts extraction degradation in MAVEN Event Detection, replicating Few-NERD finding cross-task (NER→ED)
spec.design: exp1: count curve {1,6,12,24,42,84,168} x 5 random; exp2: count={12,24} x 27 batches (25 random + extreme). Qwen3 BCS matrix. 149 active types.
spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/schema-dag-extraction && python3 src/run_experiment.py --dataset maven --mode exp1 ... && python3 src/run_experiment.py --dataset maven --mode exp2 ..."
